verses.text: <pb/><t>Me ya sa kake fariya da muguntarka,</t> <t>Ya kai, babban mutum?</t> <t>Ƙaunar Allah tana nan a koyaushe.</t>
<t>Kana shirya maƙarƙashiya don ka lalatar da waɗansu,</t> <t>Harshenka kamar aska mai kaifi yake.</t> <t>Kana ƙirƙiro ƙarairayi kullum.</t>
<t>Kana ƙaunar mugunta fiye da nagarta,</t> <t>Kana kuwa ƙaunar faɗar ƙarya fiye da gaskiya.</t>
<t>Kana jin daɗin cutar mutane da maganganunka,</t> <t>Ya kai, maƙaryaci! <pb/></t>
<t>Don haka Allah zai ɓata ka har abada,</t> <t>Zai kama ka, yă jawo ka daga alfarwarka,</t> <t>Zai kawar da kai daga ƙasar masu rai.</t>
<t>Adalai za su ga wannan, su ji tsoro,</t> <t>Za su yi maka dariya, su ce,</t>

<t>“Duba, ga mutumin da bai dogara ga Allah</t> <t>Don ya sami zaman lafiyarsa ba.</t> <t>A maimakon haka, sai ya dogara ga wadatarsa.</t> <t>Yana neman zaman lafiyarsa ta wurin muguntarsa.” <pb/></t>
<t>Amma ni, kamar itacen zaitun nake, wanda yake girma kusa da Haikalin Allah,</t> <t>Ina dogara ga madawwamiyar ƙaunarsa har abada abadin.</t>
<t>Zan gode maka, ya Ubangiji,</t> <t>Saboda abin da ka aikata.</t> <t>Zan dogara gare ka,</t> <t>Sa'ad da nake sujada tare da jama'arka,</t> <t>Domin kai mai alheri ne.</t>
